name: BITEZ Gummies 10,000MG Jarz - Delta-8 + Delta-9 + THCP - Tangerine Dream
description: Taste sweet citrus sunshine and a creamy vanilla finish with Tangerine Dream BITEZ Gummies. Each double-stacked gummy layers bright, zesty tangerine with smooth vanilla cream for that iconic orange creamsicle flavor. Your favorite childhood treat gets the BITEZ treatment, with each gummy packing a powerful 1,000mg Delta-8, Delta-9, and THCP blend (10 gummies per jar, 10,000mg total).
